v.story-le.intro.1.text: Little Tail Lake sits at the far end of the map, and its words end in a special pattern.

v.story-le.intro.2.text: A consonant followed by le often finishes a word, and it makes a soft last syllable.

v.story-le.intro.3.text: Find the last pages here, and listen for the sound that le makes at the end.

v.story-le.le-one.1.text: A table sits by the lake, and its name ends with a consonant and le.

v.story-le.le-one.2.text: The consonant and le make the last syllable, so say the ending sound clearly.

v.story-le.le-double.1.text: A little fish swims past, and its name has twin letters just before the final le.

v.story-le.le-double.2.text: Split the word before the twin letters, then read the last part as consonant and le.

v.story-le.le-mix.1.text: The last path around the lake holds a candle, a puzzle and many other long words.

v.story-le.le-mix.2.text: Take each part one at a time, use every pattern you learned, and the lake path is complete.

v.story-le.finale.1.text: The lake sparkles, and the Great Word Book is nearly whole again.

v.story-le.finale.2.text: The Keeper says, 'Well done. Every land has its words back, and one more story is waiting.'

v.story-le.end.1.text: All six crests now shine, and every torn page of the Great Word Book is back on its shelf.

v.story-le.end.2.text: The Keeper hands you the Great Word Book and says, 'You read every land. Well done, apprentice.'

v.story-le.end.3.text: Far across the water, the City of Builders waits, and it is coming later.
